_comment: POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions — updates ticket status after an action is taken in the Lighthouse dashboard. Call GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions first to resolve the correct transitionId for your Jira project workflow.

transition_to_responded._trigger: Community Manager clicks Approve & Post or auto-agent posts a reply

transition_to_escalated._trigger: Community Manager clicks Escalate in dashboard (/compliance)

transition_to_not_relevant._trigger: Community Manager marks mention as Not Relevant

transition_to_wont_respond._trigger: Community Manager marks mention as Won't Respond

_note: Transition IDs are project-specific. Resolve them at startup by calling GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions and caching the name→id map. Store in jira/client.py as TRANSITION_MAP.
